choices.content: Calculate only the volume of the small sphere
Take the difference between the surface areas
Subtract the volume of the small sphere from the volume of the large sphere

question.prompt:
If a small sphere is removed from a large sphere, how should the remaining volume be calculated?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h107_q4_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: Removing a part means taking a difference, not adding.
solutions.title: Use the whole-part relationship
